decision_cruda.rationale: N522-01 is stopped for 5-8 h, so LH-06 is idle. Norte has an empty stockpile (70/450 t) and trucks at 66 t/h, so it is not truck-limited. RS-N548-02 is the best reserve: 9.7 g/t, 350 t, 0.34 h travel, 1 h activation. Central is near its stockpile limit and inflow already exceeds trucks, so the Central reserves add little. Expect about 5.5 h at 40.8 t/h, about 225 t, about 70 oz. No loans: every other loading stope is already covered, and moving the critical-path loader LH-09 costs 5.7 oz/h.
